# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment fact documents generated for this report.

## Available Fact Documents

- [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - High-level and component-level architecture diagrams.
- [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Dependency categories and modernization risk highlights.
- [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - Service catalog, endpoint inventory, and communication sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, repository methods, and data boundaries.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, secrets, and runtime settings.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core domain workflows, sequence, and business rules.
